why: Plan round 1 and code round 1 both ended in verdict proceed; all 18 findings were rejected with reasons, no code change was needed.

findings.summary: A recovered account stays parked when its only row is excluded (no lift path without a launch)
findings.reason: Plan frozen; manual lift is out of scope by D12.

findings.summary: The 16 KiB ceiling is not bounded for changing unknown model keys
findings.reason: Plan frozen; entries expire by reset and each write drops expired ones.

findings.summary: A standing cooldown excludes the row, so the success-based Lift is unreachable after a re-login
findings.reason: Plan frozen; a try-now button is deferred by D12.

findings.summary: The guess doubling is dead because a cooldown expiry resets the counter
findings.reason: Plan frozen; 'doubling restarts after expiry' is a recorded decision (D5, S39). The code matches the plan.

findings.summary: S9 uses unprefixed keys while D3/S14/S34 use the antigravity/ prefix
findings.reason: Plan frozen; a wording point in a scenario, no defect in the code.

findings.summary: Quota keys are untyped strings across runtime boundaries
findings.reason: Out of scope: D3 fixes string QuotaKeyOf; a key type is a redesign with no behaviour.

findings.summary: The store also decides how a vendor's refusal is interpreted
findings.reason: The plan's design (D5); the structured verdict is not bypassed (Rank 0 for Spent==true, Spent passed to ReadResetAsync).

findings.summary: A slow probe's park can overwrite a newer Ok's lift
findings.reason: Outcomes carry no launch time, so order across rounds is unknowable; D5 rule spent-wins; bounded by the reset; a new feature.

findings.summary: Sequential probes can hold the round open for 90 s
findings.reason: D5 asks one call per key, each bounded at 30 s; parallel probes would share one read-only agy home; rare case.

findings.summary: Parse hides JSON errors as an empty report
findings.reason: D6/S15 pin CannotCheck('no report in the answer'); the decision is the same for every cause.
The plan's D5 signature and the recorded deviation 2; style preference.

findings.summary: Hardcoded model table drifts when models are added
findings.reason: D3 decided one explicit, measured table; S14 pins it.

findings.summary: Bucket lookup for namespaced/unknown keys gives GroupMissing
findings.reason: That is D3/D5/S14 as planned: unknown group, no probe, stated/guess for Spent==true, not parked when undecided. Both key shapes resolve the same ids.

findings.summary: Lock/directory I/O exceptions can escape Mutate
findings.reason: Already covered: FolderRefusal, Hold.Unusable/Busy mapped to Refused (S37), and AfterRoundAsync catches Exception.

findings.summary: Vendor text is not truncated before it is combined into the note
findings.reason: Wrong: VendorReason.Written caps it (SafetyCap), output is bounded by the launcher, the note is capped at 400.

findings.summary: Every CanRun/ProbeAsync reads and parses the JSON file
findings.reason: D4 decided: read on every decision, no cache (two processes, under 16 KiB).

findings.summary: The stored note bakes in a stale relative duration
findings.reason: Wrong: the note holds absolute ISO UTC instants only; 'in N h' is computed live (CooldownSentences, cooldownWords.ts).
Bounded: only on a non-zero exit, stderr capped by the launcher; no measurement.
